verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents an official CLI at docs.crossplane.io/cli. It covers rendering and testing Composition Functions without a cluster, troubleshooting Compositions, XRs and MRs, and building, installing and pushing packages, with versioned downloads via XP_CHANNEL/XP_VERSION. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances (e.g., machine-readable output for AI workflows), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: testing and rendering standalone Composition Functions without the need to access a Kubernetes cluster running Crossplane
troubleshooting Crossplane Compositions, Composite Resources and Managed Resources
building, installing, updating and pushing Crossplane Packages
You can download different Crossplane CLI versions or different release branches with the `XP_CHANNEL` and `XP_VERSION` environmental variables.
